completion.contextual_prefix_definition: applied_path from root through the first occurrence of the exact component, inclusive

recovery.contextual_prefix_definition: applied_path from root through the first occurrence of the exact component, inclusive

bad_completion_occurrences.definition: Bad-side row weight whose frozen applied path contains the exact component 'report completion'.

bad_completion_share.definition: Bad completion occurrences divided by all bad occurrences.

bad_operation_occurrences.definition: Sum of integer value over the pair-expanded bad-side rows.

bad_recovery_occurrences.definition: Bad-side row weight whose frozen applied path contains the exact component 'recover interaction'.

bad_recovery_share.definition: Bad recovery occurrences divided by all bad occurrences.

consensus_looping_trajectories.definition: Unique pair-population trajectories with unanimous Yes/No expert trajectory_looping annotations.

fixed_chain_projection_ap.definition: Ordinary non-interpolated AP of the unique-trajectory fraction whose fixed-chain result is repeated or starts with error:.

good_completion_occurrences.definition: Good-side row weight whose frozen applied path contains the exact component 'report completion'.

good_completion_share.definition: Good completion occurrences divided by all good occurrences.

good_operation_occurrences.definition: Sum of integer value over the pair-expanded good-side rows.

good_recovery_occurrences.definition: Good-side row weight whose frozen applied path contains the exact component 'recover interaction'.

good_recovery_share.definition: Good recovery occurrences divided by all good occurrences.

looping_prevalence.definition: Consensus looping positives divided by eligible trajectories.

pair_occurrences.definition: Number of rows in the fixed pair manifest.

recursive_minus_fixed_95ci.definition: 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of recursive recovery AP minus fixed-chain AP under the same task-cluster bootstrap draw.

recursive_minus_prevalence_95ci.definition: 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of recovery AP minus resample prevalence under task-cluster bootstrap.

recursive_recovery_ap.definition: Ordinary non-interpolated AP of unique-trajectory recovery exposure against consensus expert looping labels.

scoring_details.fixed_projection_definition: unique operations with result == repeated or result starting with error: / unique operations in trajectory
